Universe’26 · Section 3 · Final exercise

Attach a cheat sheet artifact

Use the /create-issue-artifact skill to attach a cheat sheet of the top Virtual Universe updates to an issue.

5 min · 3 steps
Issue Artifacts attach plans, notes, design docs, images and links directly to a GitHub issue, so important context doesn’t get lost in comments.

  1. Open an issue session

    /create-issue-artifact attaches to the issue linked to the session you run it in. Ask Copilot to create the issue in your fork and open a session for it.

    Copilot chat 
    Create an issue titled "My GitHub Universe '26 cheat sheet" in my fork and open a session for it

    Switch to the new session when Copilot opens it.

  2. Run the skill

    In the new issue session, run:

    Copilot chat · issue session
    /create-issue-artifact follow github-virtual-universe-highlights/attach-a-cheat-sheet-artifact/instructions.md

    Copilot reads the recap pages, designs a one-page cheat sheet in the Universe theme, makes a ✨surprise card✨, and adds both to your issue as artifacts.

  3. Open your issue

    Open the issue and select Artifacts. Read the surprise card to find an easter egg in your Virtual GitHub Universe Badge.

🎉 That’s the end of the workshop. Thanks for building with us! See the Universe recap for more.
